# Fitted Card

## Summary
The presentation shell for a card rendered in its fitted format.

## Shape
Fitted is the hardest format because the box size is not the card's choice — the same card must
read correctly in a wide table row and a small tile. This shell resolves that: `@layout` takes a
`FittedCardLayout` and `@titleTag` a `FittedCardTitleTag` so heading semantics stay right at
every size, while `@imageUrl` with `@imageAlt` and `@imageLoading` handle the thumbnail. The
yielded blocks — `background`, `badge`, `badgeLeft`, `badgeRight`, `badgeRow` — are what let a
consumer decorate the card without re-implementing the layout it just picked.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/fitted-card/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { FittedCard } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
